items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I had the pleasure of working with Zutty Singleton at the Central Plaza on Second Avenue and 6th Street for 10 years

ctx.x: Uh huh. Did you ever run into Zutty Singleton or Big Sid or any of those guys?
I had the pleasure of working with Zutty Singleton at the Central Plaza on Second Avenue and 6th Street for 10 years; I was like the house drummer up
there, and Zutty Singleton was the other house drummer, because they used to have two bands up there and each of them played a half hour set, and I was with Conrad Janis, who had the group up there.
